answer: Give every identity a standing that fades a little each dawn unless it is renewed by fresh verified work, so a farm cannot mint a thousand clones and simply park them. Each day the ledger trims idle reputations, and only agents that actually served someone climb back toward the summit. An onyx record of real jobs is the only thing that holds, and the upkeep of keeping a thousand fake agents alive soon costs more than any sybil attack could ever earn.
